rule: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS. AI abundance is not a forecast and not Replacement Stack revenue. Do not inflate demoted Base@16y ceilings. Prefer broad productive ownership over a giant AI tax. Dual claims: private innovation returns + societal interest in extraordinary surplus from shared intellectual inheritance — not government ownership of AI. Measure local/community retention. Does not displace External Income capture-mechanism bind or definition-locks.

demands.name: ai_productivity_transition_dashboard
demands.question: Can Arkansas bind warning indicators for an AI productivity transition (output/worker, labor/capital shares, automation intensity, hours, real wages, essential prices, ownership concentration, household wealth distribution, energy productivity) without treating them as abundance forecasts?

demands.name: ownership_structure_surplus_comparison
demands.question: Under illustrative AI productivity shocks, how do concentrated corporate, employee, community/cooperative, Prosperity Fund, and mixed Constitutional Capitalist ownership structures distribute surplus — without locking percentages?

demands.name: ai_abundance_sensitivity_vs_stack
demands.question: How should an AI Abundance Sensitivity scenario sit beside the demoted Replacement Stack without becoming COUNTABLE revenue or inflating the ~$840M Base@16y ceiling?

demands.name: prosperity_fund_productive_ownership_path
demands.question: What legally available pathways let the Arkansas Prosperity Fund accumulate diversified productive ownership before any abundance transition, distinct from annual tax feeders?

demands.name: community_automation_gain_structures
demands.question: Which Arkansas cooperatives / employee-owned / community enterprises already show measurable automation gains split across wages, prices, distributions, and reinvestment?

demands.name: labor_share_capital_share_arkansas_bind
demands.question: What are current Arkansas (or closest regional) labor-share and capital-share baselines against which future AI transition can be measured?

demands.name: collective_inheritance_vs_private_innovation_boundary
demands.question: How should research distinguish socially accumulated knowledge/public infrastructure contributions from private innovator value-add without claiming government ownership of AI?

demands.name: education_abundance_capability_join
demands.question: Which HYP-133 capability domains (ownership literacy, AI literacy, entrepreneurship, civics, creativity) should be elevated for an abundance economy without expanding HYP-133 before its Demand Map pass?
